title: Improve Network worker state readability
summary: Improve the Network page Persisted Worker State panel by rendering persisted-state lines as readable row tiles with bounded scrolling.
reason: The persisted worker state panel compressed status, counts, file paths, and warnings into a dense preformatted block, making it harder to scan than the surrounding Network tiles.
behavior_before: Persisted Worker State guidance rendered as a dense preformatted prose block.
behavior_after: Persisted Worker State guidance renders as readable row tiles with label/value emphasis, section rows for warning groups, and a bounded scroll area.
rollback_plan: Revert the Network worker summary container to pre.prose-block markup, restore setText for network-worker-summary, remove the worker summary CSS modifiers and smoke assertion, and remove this change packet.
notes: Rendered Persisted Worker State summary as readable row tiles with bounded scrolling.
